title: Run de-id re-scan on the ingested batch; publish quarantine report
context: Following ingest (pathology-image-benchmarks-ingest-001), every slide in the batch must be screened for burned-in PHI before any derived artifact (tile, thumbnail, feature) is produced. The screening procedure was defined in pathology-image-benchmarks-deid-001: extract label/macro/associated images, scan filenames and metadata, apply OCR + heuristics, quarantine any positive, update deidStatus in the manifest. No derived artifact may be produced from an unscanned slide. This task runs the de-id re-scan on the real ingested batch and publishes a quarantine report. Output is verification/metadata only; controlled-access or identifiable data must never appear in any artifact.
objective: Implement and run the WSI de-id re-scan pipeline (per the policy in pathology-image-benchmarks-deid-001) on the ingested batch: extract label, macro, and associated images from each slide; scan filenames and embedded metadata; apply OCR and text/face heuristics; update deidStatus (passed|quarantined|manual-cleared) in the per-slide manifest; exclude any quarantined slide from all derived artifacts. Publish a quarantine report listing screened count, passed count, quarantined count, and screening method. Slide-label and macro images must not be published in any artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% of ingested slides are screened (label image, macro image, associated/auxiliary images, embedded metadata, and filenames).
Any positive screening result automatically sets deidStatus: quarantined in the manifest and excludes the slide from all derived artifacts pending manual review.
A quarantine report is published listing: total screened, total passed, total quarantined, the screening method used, and the manual-review SLA.
No slide-label or macro image appears in any published artifact.
No derived artifact (tile, thumbnail, feature) references a slide with deidStatus other than passed or manual-cleared.
The de-id scan results are recorded as verification/metadata only; no identifiable patient data is included in any output artifact.
output: Updated per-slide manifest records with deidStatus fields populated, and a published quarantine report (screened/passed/quarantined counts, screening method) committed as a verification artifact.
